result_text:
I changed the `all_files.zip` export in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java` so the entry names come from the configured aspect names. The module compiles. I didn't run any tests or try a renamed aspect.

The five scope aspects (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other) are now each read and named through `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`. That is the same call the loose `aspect_<name>.txt` files are written with, so the two always match.

- **Default config:** the entries should stay `aspect_main.txt`, `aspect_test.txt`, `aspect_generated.txt`, `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`, `aspect_other.txt`, in that order.
- **Renamed aspect:** the fourth entry should become `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. The zip step should no longer throw, so `git-history.zip` should be written too when `git-history.txt` exists.

I left the hardcoded names in `LandscapeAnalyzer.java` (lines 280–284) alone. They read the same `aspect_*.txt` files, so a renamed aspect would likely break them in the same way, but that wasn't part of this task.
